checks.why: every curve written here is keyed in film frames and extrapolates CONSTANT to the last one
every transform in the bake is world metres
this applier supplies that glazing at 14.95500..14.96650 with real thickness; two east walls 33.5 mm apart z-fight in beat 1 and leave a ghost pane in the aperture afterwards
that is the pocket the glass lives in; a solid mullion or sill laid through it starts every clamped shard inside metal, which is exactly what the null control caught

preflight.R5_measures: vertices inside the pocket, AND triangles intersecting it by the separating-axis theorem. The triangle arm exists because round 1's east mullions pass through the pocket with every vertex AND every edge outside it -- it is their side FACES that cross -- and the vertex-only test reported `clear` on 29,387 meshes.

east_wall.criterion: the east wall must contain glass at frame 1: every bay in the plan has a GP_b* pane and it is not hidden there
east_wall.note: n_GW_Right_Glass counts ROUND 1's names and reads 0 for a correct scene as well as an empty one.  Count GP_b*.

origin_rule: shard origin = (0.5*(x_in+x_out), centroid_u, centroid_v) in WORLD metres; mesh verts are stored relative to it
